description: Partner pack for Sei v2 — parallelized EVM + native Cosmos interop, sub-400ms block time. Biases toward trading, orderbook DEXes, and latency-sensitive payments.

defaults.headline: Ship on Sei — parallel EVM + Cosmos interop
defaults.subheadline: Sub-400ms finality optimized for trading, orderbook DEXes, and real-time payments.

buildHints.whenToUse: Prompt mentions Sei, parallelized EVM with Cosmos-style interop, or orderbook-style on-chain trading venues.
firstSteps: Sei v2 chainId (mainnet): 1329; testnet (atlantic-2): 1328. RPCs in partner-config.json default to the public endpoints.
Use the same forge/hardhat toolchain as any EVM; Sei v2 is fully EVM-equivalent at the RPC level.
For native Cosmos flows (IBC transfers, staking), use sei-js or CosmJS alongside viem — don't try to route Cosmos messages through evm RPC.
gotchas: Sei v1 (Cosmos-only) and Sei v2 (EVM) share ecosystem but are different execution layers. Make sure code targets v2 RPC if deploying Solidity.
Block time ~390ms is faster than most indexers default to — reduce poll intervals for live dashboards or use WebSocket subscriptions.
